dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk @BillyM2k The Dogecoin network itself also has a huge problem.

To protect the blockchain from manipulation, it needs a lot of computing power. However, the Dogecoin network does not have this computing power.
@elonmusk @BillyM2k In Dogecoin’s official GitHub repository you can see that the last commit was a few months ago. Most of the source code files have not been changed for months or even years.

@elonmusk @BillyM2k Most cryptocurrencies have huge teams working on them. Besides the permanent employees, fans also contribute to the open-source code of the projects.
what about the team behind the Doge coin?
